issues: The light full-page screenshot filled the frame with no stage, light or depth; it read as a screenshot panning
Rows only dropped 120px in 2D with no real height, so the 'embed' read like a sticker
The camera stayed frontal with a slight tilt-down, flat rhythm and no arc
In 68 frames the last row landed at 58 and the shot ended with the seam; no settled hold
changes: Look switched to an ember warm-dark stage: only the 'research questions' section of the real screenshot becomes a rounded panel with two soft shadows, a hairline and top light, matching the page's own vermilion accent
The camera is now a single crane: a 40° low oblique opening that straightens and pushes in as rows land, settling frontal at 86f so the dense list ends readable

Rows drop from a real 3D height of 250px above the panel, hinged at the bottom edge with the top lifted 16° before closing, with a shadow that tightens as they descend, slamming into the slot with a press rebound
Rhythm is an accelerating 12→7f row rain; duration 68→112f, the last row lands at 62f followed by ~40f of frontal hold
The seam widens to 3px with a faint orange under-glow; the panel is laid out at target scale and the 3D only rotates, so the screenshot text stays crisp
